## Test evidence

How you verified this (test output, a command you ran, a screenshot).
"It should work" is not evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), per the DCO in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] No code, assets, schemas, or configuration copied from a third-party
      or reference repository (ADR-017, `docs/specs/reference-register.md`).
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or customer data in the diff.
- [ ] If this changes a contract in spec sections 7-13, an ADR is included
      or linked.
- [ ] Tenant isolation and the clean-room boundary are intact.
